column5:
Chỉ số rủi ro hệ thống tổng hợp từ các yếu tố:
▪ Thanh khoản
▪ Biến động chỉ số VN-Index
▪ Dư nợ margin
▪ Lãi suất liên ngân hàng
▪ Dòng tiền ròng NĐTNN
▪ Huy động vốn cổ phần thông qua thị trường chứng khoán
▪ Risk Index được tính toán theo công thức hồi quy (Logistic Regression):
RI = β0 + β1*Z_L + β2*Z_V + β3*Z_M + β4*Z_I + β5*Z_F + β6*Z_C + ε
Trong đó:
o Các biến Z là các giá trị đã được chuẩn hóa (Z-Score) của các yếu tố đầu vào
o Biến động (Volatility - V): Độ lệch chuẩn của lợi suất chỉ số VN-Index trong 30 phiên gần nhất.
o Thanh khoản (Liquidity - L): Chỉ số Amihud (ILLIQ) phản ánh mức độ thanh khoản của thị trường.
o Dư nợ ký quỹ (Margin Debt - M): Tỷ lệ Dư nợ Margin trên Tổng vốn hóa thị trường.
o Lãi suất (Interest Rate - I): Lãi suất liên ngân hàng.
o Dòng tiền ròng NĐTNN (Net Foreign - F)
o Huy động vốn cổ phần (Equity Capital Raising - C)
▪ Các giá trị β, ε do cán bộ/chuyên viên nhập.
▪ Công thức chuẩn hóa Z-Score:
1. Công thức tổng quát:
Z-score = (x − μ) / σ

WITH close_price AS (
-- Bước 0: lấy đúng 1 dòng/ngày = giá đóng cửa (bản ghi indexTime lớn nhất)
SELECT TradingDate,
marketIndex AS CloseIndex
FROM MarketInfor
WHERE IndexCode = 'VNINDEX'
AND TradingDate <= :input_date
AND indexTime = (
SELECT MAX(m2.indexTime)
FROM MarketInfor m2
WHERE m2.IndexCode = 'VNINDEX'
AND m2.TradingDate = MarketInfor.TradingDate
)
),
daily_ret AS (
-- Bước 1: tính log return, lấy 31 ngày → được 30 log-return sau khi LAG cho NULL ở dòng đầu
SELECT TradingDate,
LN(CloseIndex / LAG(CloseIndex) OVER (ORDER BY TradingDate)) AS r
FROM close_price
ORDER BY TradingDate DESC
FETCH FIRST 31 ROWS ONLY -- Oracle 19c; đổi thành LIMIT 31 nếu PostgreSQL
),
vol30 AS (
-- Bước 2: tính σ_t = độ lệch chuẩn mẫu của 30 log-return
SELECT STDDEV_SAMP(r) AS sigma_v
FROM daily_ret
WHERE r IS NOT NULL
),
hist AS (
-- Bước 3: lấy μ và σ lịch sử từ DWH để chuẩn hóa
SELECT AVG(sigma_v_hist) AS mu,
STDDEV_SAMP(sigma_v_hist) AS sd
FROM mart.volatility_history
WHERE trading_date <= :input_date
)
-- Bước 4: Z-score = (σ_t − μ) / σ_lịch_sử
SELECT v.sigma_v AS volatility_30d,
h.mu AS mu_hist,
h.sd AS sd_hist,
(v.sigma_v - h.mu) / NULLIF(h.sd, 0) AS z_score_volatility
FROM vol30 v
CROSS JOIN hist h;

WITH idx_return AS (
-- Tính lợi suất log từng ngày trước
SELECT
trading_date,
ABS(LN(close_index / NULLIF(LAG(close_index) OVER (ORDER BY trading_date), 0))) AS abs_rt
FROM MarketInfor
WHERE index_code = 'VNINDEX'
),
illiq_d AS (
-- Tính ILLIQₜ = |Rₜ| / VOLDₜ mỗi ngày
SELECT
t.trade_date,
r.abs_rt / NULLIF(SUM(t.exec_value), 0) AS illiq_t
FROM trade_all t
JOIN idx_return r ON r.trading_date = t.trade_date
WHERE t.market_id IN ('STO', 'STX', 'UPX')
AND t.board_type IN ('G1', 'G2', 'G3')
AND t.trade_date <= :input_date
GROUP BY t.trade_date, r.abs_rt
ORDER BY t.trade_date DESC
FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY
),
illiq_30 AS (
-- ILLIQ30 = trung bình 30 phiên gần nhất
SELECT AVG(illiq_t) AS illiq_avg
FROM illiq_d
)
SELECT
(illiq_30.illiq_avg - hist.mu) / NULLIF(hist.sd, 0) AS z_score_liquidity,
STDDEV_SAMP(h.illiq_30_hist) AS sigma_illiq
FROM illiq_30,
(
SELECT
AVG(illiq_30_hist) AS mu,
STDDEV_SAMP(illiq_30_hist) AS sd
FROM mart.illiq_history
WHERE trading_date <= :input_date
) hist,
mart.illiq_history h
WHERE h.trading_date <= :input_date
GROUP BY illiq_30.illiq_avg, hist.mu, hist.sd;

-- Dư nợ margin
SELECT
nd.ngay,
SUM(TO_NUMBER(gt.GIA_TRI)) AS du_no_margin
FROM (
SELECT TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 AS ngay
FROM (
SELECT MIN(gt.NGAY_SO_LIEU) AS min_ngay
FROM SCMS.BC_BAO_CAO_GT gt
JOIN SCMS.DM_CHI_TIEU dct ON dct.ID = gt.DM_CHI_TIEU_ID
WHERE dct.TEN_CHI_TIEU = 'Giá trị chứng khoán ký quỹ' -- Check
)
CONNECT BY TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
) nd
LEFT JOIN SCMS.BC_BAO_CAO_GT gt
JOIN SCMS.DM_CHI_TIEU dct ON dct.ID = gt.DM_CHI_TIEU_ID
ON dct.TEN_CHI_TIEU = 'Giá trị chứng khoán ký quỹ' -- Check
AND TRUNC(gt.NGAY_SO_LIEU) = nd.ngay
GROUP BY nd.ngay
ORDER BY nd.ngay;

WITH avg_rate AS (
SELECT v.indicator_value,
v.trading_date,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY v.trading_date DESC) AS rn
FROM risk_indicator_value v
JOIN risk_indicator i ON i.id = v.risk_indicator_id
WHERE i.indicator_code = 'INTERBANK_IR'
AND v.trading_date <= :input_date
),
stats AS (
SELECT AVG(indicator_value) AS mu_ir,
STDDEV_SAMP(indicator_value) AS sigma_ir
FROM avg_rate
WHERE rn <= :n_periods
),
ir_t AS (
SELECT indicator_value AS ir_current
FROM avg_rate
WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT ir_t.ir_current AS ir_t,
s.mu_ir,
s.sigma_ir,
(ir_t.ir_current - s.mu_ir)
/ NULLIF(s.sigma_ir, 0) AS z_score_interest_rate
FROM ir_t, stats s;

WITH close_price AS (
-- Bước 0: lấy đúng 1 dòng/ngày = giá đóng cửa (bản ghi indexTime lớn nhất)
SELECT TradingDate,
marketIndex AS CloseIndex
FROM MarketInfor
WHERE IndexCode = 'VNINDEX'
AND TradingDate <= :input_date
AND indexTime = (
SELECT MAX(m2.indexTime)
FROM MarketInfor m2
WHERE m2.IndexCode = 'VNINDEX'
AND m2.TradingDate = MarketInfor.TradingDate
)
),
daily_ret AS (
-- Bước 1: tính log return, lấy 31 ngày → được 30 log-return sau khi LAG cho NULL ở dòng đầu
SELECT TradingDate,
LN(CloseIndex / LAG(CloseIndex) OVER (ORDER BY TradingDate)) AS r
FROM close_price
ORDER BY TradingDate DESC
FETCH FIRST 31 ROWS ONLY -- Oracle 19c; đổi thành LIMIT 31 nếu PostgreSQL
),
vol30 AS (
-- Bước 2: tính σ_t = độ lệch chuẩn mẫu của 30 log-return
SELECT STDDEV_SAMP(r) AS sigma_v
FROM daily_ret
WHERE r IS NOT NULL
),
hist AS (
-- Bước 3: lấy μ và σ lịch sử từ DWH để chuẩn hóa
SELECT AVG(sigma_v_hist) AS mu,
STDDEV_SAMP(sigma_v_hist) AS sd
FROM mart.volatility_history
WHERE trading_date <= :input_date
)
-- Bước 4: Z-score = (σ_t − μ) / σ_lịch_sử
SELECT v.sigma_v AS volatility_30d,
h.mu AS mu_hist,
h.sd AS sd_hist,
(v.sigma_v - h.mu) / NULLIF(h.sd, 0) AS z_score_volatility
FROM vol30 v
CROSS JOIN hist h;

(CAST(totalTrading AS NUMERIC)

S_liquidity = 50 + Sign(PriceChange) × min((Vt / MAvol(20)) × 25, 50)

column19:
WITH daily_vol AS (
SELECT
sub.ngay_gd,
SUM(sub.kl_gd) AS kl_gd_ngay,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sub.ngay_gd DESC) AS rn
FROM (
SELECT
t.[Trade Date] AS ngay_gd,
t.[Execution - Volume] AS kl_gd
FROM Trade_HOSE t
JOIN CSIDXInfor idx
ON t.Symbol = idx.symbol
AND t.[Trade Date] = idx.tradingdate
AND idx.indexCode = :ma_chi_so
WHERE t.[Trade Date] <= :input_date
AND t.[Market ID] = 'STO'
UNION ALL
SELECT
t.[Trade date] AS ngay_gd,
t.[Trade quantity] AS kl_gd
FROM Trade_HNX t
JOIN CSIDXInfor idx
ON t.[Issue Code] = idx.symbol
AND t.[Trade date] = idx.tradingdate
AND idx.indexCode = :ma_chi_so
WHERE t.[Trade date] <= :input_date
AND t.[Market ID] IN ('STX', 'UPX')
) sub
GROUP BY sub.ngay_gd
),
ma_vol AS (
SELECT AVG(kl_gd_ngay) AS mavol_20
FROM daily_vol
WHERE rn <= 20
),
vt AS (
SELECT kl_gd_ngay AS vol_t
FROM daily_vol
WHERE rn = 1
),
price_t AS (
SELECT
open_index,
close_index,
CASE
WHEN close_index > open_index THEN 1
WHEN close_index < open_index THEN -1
ELSE 0
END AS sign_price_change
FROM MarketInfor
WHERE index_code = :ma_chi_so
AND trading_date = :input_date
),
flow AS (
SELECT
v.vol_t / NULLIF(m.mavol_20, 0) AS flow_ratio
FROM vt v, ma_vol m
)
SELECT
p.open_index,
p.close_index,
p.sign_price_change,
f.flow_ratio,
50 + p.sign_price_change
* LEAST((f.flow_ratio * 25), 50) AS s_liquidity
FROM price_t p, flow f;

WITH trading_dates_current AS (
SELECT TradingDate
FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT TradingDate,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TradingDate DESC) AS rn
FROM MarketInfor
WHERE IndexCode = 'VNINDEX'
AND TradingDate <= :input_date
)

close_prices_current AS (
SELECT
m.TradingDate,
m.marketIndex AS close_index
FROM MarketInfor m
WHERE m.IndexCode = 'VNINDEX'
AND m.TradingDate IN (SELECT TradingDate FROM trading_dates_current)
AND m.indexTime = (

FROM MarketInfor
WHERE IndexCode = 'VNINDEX'
AND TradingDate = m.TradingDate
)
),
daily_return_current AS (
SELECT
cp.TradingDate,
(cp.close_index - prev.close_index)
/ NULLIF(prev.close_index, 0) AS rt
FROM close_prices_current cp
JOIN close_prices_current prev
ON prev.TradingDate = (
SELECT MAX(TradingDate)
FROM close_prices_current
WHERE TradingDate < cp.TradingDate
)
),
sigma_current AS (
SELECT STDDEV(rt) * SQRT(252) AS sigma_cur
FROM daily_return_current
),
-- Tính σ_max: stddev cao nhất lịch sử theo rolling 20 phiên
all_close_prices AS (
SELECT
m.TradingDate,
m.marketIndex AS close_index
FROM MarketInfor m
WHERE m.IndexCode = 'VNINDEX'
AND m.indexTime = (
SELECT MAX(indexTime)
FROM MarketInfor
WHERE IndexCode = 'VNINDEX'
AND TradingDate = m.TradingDate
)
),

cp.TradingDate,
(cp.close_index - prev.close_index)
/ NULLIF(prev.close_index, 0) AS rt
FROM all_close_prices cp
JOIN all_close_prices prev
ON prev.TradingDate = (
SELECT MAX(TradingDate)
FROM all_close_prices
WHERE TradingDate < cp.TradingDate
)
),
rolling_sigma AS (
SELECT
TradingDate,
STDDEV(rt) OVER (
ORDER BY TradingDate
ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
) * SQRT(252) AS sigma_rolling
FROM all_daily_return
),
sigma_max AS (
SELECT MAX(sigma_rolling) AS sigma_max
FROM rolling_sigma
WHERE TradingDate <= :input_date
)
SELECT
:input_date AS trading_date,
sigma_current.sigma_cur AS sigma_current,
sigma_max.sigma_max AS sigma_max,
ROUND(
sigma_current.sigma_cur
/ NULLIF(sigma_max.sigma_max, 0) * 100,
2
) AS systemic_vol_pct
FROM sigma_current, sigma_max;

WITH daily_ret AS (
SELECT symbol, tradingdate,
LN(CAST(closePrice AS NUMERIC)/
LAG(CAST(closePrice AS NUMERIC)) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY tradingdate)) AS r
FROM StockInfor
WHERE FloorCode IN ('02','04','10')
AND tradingdate <= :input_date
),
sigma AS (
SELECT symbol, STDDEV(r) AS sigma_i
FROM daily_ret
WHERE r IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY symbol
),
sigma_range AS (
SELECT MIN(sigma_i) AS sigma_min, MAX(sigma_i) AS sigma_max FROM sigma
)
SELECT s.symbol,
(s.sigma_i - sr.sigma_min) / NULLIF(sr.sigma_max - sr.sigma_min, 0) * 100 AS pvolatility_i
FROM sigma s CROSS JOIN sigma_range sr

column19:
WITH hnx_upcom AS (
SELECT
t.[Issue Code] AS symbol,
t.[Trade date] AS ngay_gd,
t.[Market ID] AS market_id,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy investor classification code] = '8000'
AND t.[Buy Foreigner Investor type] = '00'
THEN CAST(t.[Trade price] AS NUMERIC)
* CAST(t.[Trade quantity] AS NUMERIC)
ELSE 0 END) AS gt_mua,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell investor classification code] = '8000'
AND t.[Sell Foreigner Investor type] = '00'
THEN CAST(t.[Trade price] AS NUMERIC)
* CAST(t.[Trade quantity] AS NUMERIC)
ELSE 0 END) AS gt_ban
FROM Trade_HNX t
WHERE t.[Trade date] = :ngay_gd
AND t.[Market ID] IN ('STO', 'STX', 'UPX')
AND (
(t.[Buy investor classification code] = '8000'
AND t.[Buy Foreigner Investor type] = '00')
OR (t.[Sell investor classification code] = '8000'
AND t.[Sell Foreigner Investor type] = '00')
)
GROUP BY t.[Issue Code], t.[Trade date], t.[Market ID]
),
hose AS (
SELECT
t.Symbol AS symbol,
t.[Trade Date] AS ngay_gd,
t.[Market ID] AS market_id,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy - Invest Type] = '1100'
THEN t.[Execution - Value]
ELSE 0 END) AS gt_mua,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell - Invest Type] = '1100'
THEN t.[Execution - Value]
ELSE 0 END) AS gt_ban
FROM Trade_HOSE t
WHERE t.[Trade Date] = :ngay_gd
AND t.[Market ID] = 'STO'
AND (
t.[Buy - Invest Type] = '1100'
OR t.[Sell - Invest Type] = '1100'
)
GROUP BY t.Symbol, t.[Trade Date], t.[Market ID]
),
all_data AS (
SELECT * FROM hnx_upcom
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM hose
)
-- Tính từng sàn
SELECT
market_id,
ngay_gd,
SUM(gt_mua) AS gtgd_mua_ca_nhan,
SUM(gt_ban) AS gtgd_ban_ca_nhan,
SUM(gt_mua) + SUM(gt_ban) AS gtgd_nha_dau_tu
FROM all_data
GROUP BY market_id, ngay_gd
UNION ALL
-- Tính toàn thị trường
SELECT
'TOTAL' AS market_id,
ngay_gd,
SUM(gt_mua) AS gtgd_mua_ca_nhan,
SUM(gt_ban) AS gtgd_ban_ca_nhan,
SUM(gt_mua) + SUM(gt_ban) AS gtgd_nha_dau_tu
FROM all_data
GROUP BY ngay_gd;

AND "tradingdate" = :to_date
) CP ON CP.rn = 1 AND CP."IssuerName" = TP."IssuerName"
JOIN IDS.company_profiles p ON p.equity_ticker = CP.equity_ticker
JOIN IDS.categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
JOIN IDS.company_data e ON e.company_profile_id = p.id
JOIN IDS.data d ON d.company_data_id = e.company_data_id
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id

AND e.report_quarter = :quarter

(rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'dn' AND rr.row_desc = '300')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'bh' AND rr.row_desc = '300')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'td' AND rr.row_desc = '400')

WITH bq AS (
SELECT cp.equity_listing_exch_cd, cat.industry_cd, cat.industry_name,
cp.report_type_cd, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc='2' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS vcsh_dau,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc='1' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS vcsh_cuoi
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd=d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd=d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp ON cp.id=cd.company_profile_id
JOIN IDS.categories cat ON cat.id=cp.category_id
WHERE cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%' AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='400') OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='400') OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='500'))
GROUP BY cp.equity_listing_exch_cd, cat.industry_cd, cat.industry_name, cp.report_type_cd, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
), ln AS (
SELECT cp.equity_listing_exch_cd, cat.industry_cd, cat.industry_name,
cp.report_type_cd, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter,
SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd=d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd=d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp ON cp.id=cd.company_profile_id
JOIN IDS.categories cat ON cat.id=cp.category_id
WHERE rc2.col_desc='1' AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
AND cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='60') OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='60') OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
GROUP BY cp.equity_listing_exch_cd, cat.industry_cd, cat.industry_name, cp.report_type_cd, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
)
SELECT b.equity_listing_exch_cd, b.industry_cd, b.industry_name,
b.report_type_cd, b.report_year, b.report_quarter,
ROUND(SUM(l.lnst)/NULLIF(SUM(
CASE WHEN b.vcsh_dau IS NULL THEN b.vcsh_cuoi
WHEN b.vcsh_cuoi IS NULL THEN b.vcsh_dau
ELSE (b.vcsh_dau+b.vcsh_cuoi)/2 END),0)*100,4) AS roe_pct
FROM bq b JOIN ln l
ON l.equity_listing_exch_cd=b.equity_listing_exch_cd
AND l.industry_cd=b.industry_cd AND l.report_type_cd=b.report_type_cd
AND l.report_year=b.report_year AND l.report_quarter=b.report_quarter
GROUP BY cp.equity_listing_exch_cd, cat.industry_cd, cat.industry_name, cp.report_type_cd, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter

WITH

-- Tính năm/quý của kỳ TRƯỚC
prev_period AS (
SELECT
CASE WHEN :quarter = 1 THEN :year - 1 ELSE :year END AS prev_year,
CASE WHEN :quarter = 1 THEN 4 ELSE :quarter - 1 END AS prev_quarter
),

-- Danh sách TPDN niêm yết: lấy bản ghi cuối cùng trong ngày
tp AS (
SELECT
s."symbol",
s."IssuerName",
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s."symbol" ORDER BY s."ts" DESC) AS rn
FROM MDDS.StockInfor s
WHERE s."FloorCode" = '06'
AND s."tradingdate" = :to_date
),

-- Mã cổ phiếu tương ứng: link qua IssuerName
cp AS (
SELECT
s."symbol" AS equity_ticker,
s."IssuerName",
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s."symbol" ORDER BY s."ts" DESC) AS rn
FROM MDDS.StockInfor s
WHERE s."FloorCode" IN ('02', '04', '10')
AND s."tradingdate" = :to_date
)

SELECT
tp."symbol" AS ma_tp,
c.industry_cd AS ma_nganh,
c.industry_name AS ten_nganh,
cp.equity_ticker AS ma_ck,
pp.prev_year AS nam_dau_ky,
pp.prev_quarter AS quy_dau_ky,
SUM(d.data_value) AS vcsh_dau_ky

FROM tp
CROSS JOIN prev_period pp
JOIN cp ON cp.rn = 1 AND cp."IssuerName" = tp."IssuerName"
JOIN IDS.company_profiles p ON p.equity_ticker = cp.equity_ticker
JOIN IDS.categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
JOIN IDS.company_data e ON e.company_profile_id = p.id -- Lấy kỳ TRƯỚC (= đầu kỳ hiện tại)
AND e.report_year = pp.prev_year
AND e.report_quarter = pp.prev_quarter
JOIN IDS.data d ON d.company_data_id = e.company_data_id
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id = rc.id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
WHERE tp.rn = 1
AND rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
AND (
(rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'dn' AND rr.row_desc = '400')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'bh' AND rr.row_desc = '400')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'td' AND rr.row_desc = '500')
)

GROUP BY
tp."symbol",
c.industry_cd,
c.industry_name,
cp.equity_ticker,
pp.prev_year,
pp.prev_quarter;

-- Margin/VCSH %
WITH nd AS (
SELECT TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 AS ngay
FROM (
SELECT MIN(bt.NGAY_SO_LIEU) AS min_ngay
FROM SCMS.BC_BAO_CAO_GT gt
JOIN SCMS.DM_CHI_TIEU dct ON dct.ID = gt.DM_CHI_TIEU_ID
JOIN SCMS.BC_THANH_VIEN bt ON bt.ID = gt.BC_THANH_VIEN_ID
WHERE dct.MA_CHI_TIEU = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' -- Xác nhận
-- AND bt.CTCK_THONG_TIN_ID = :p_ctck_id
AND bt.TRANG_THAI IN (4, 6)
AND bt.XOA_DU_LIEU = 0
)
CONNECT BY TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
)
SELECT
nd.ngay,
ROUND(TO_NUMBER(margin_gt.GIA_TRI) / NULLIF(TO_NUMBER(vcsh_gt.GIA_TRI), 0) * 100, 2) 
AS ty_le_margin_tren_vcsh
FROM nd
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT
TRUNC(bt.NGAY_SO_LIEU) AS ngay,
gt.GIA_TRI
FROM SCMS.BC_BAO_CAO_GT gt
JOIN SCMS.DM_CHI_TIEU dct ON dct.ID = gt.DM_CHI_TIEU_ID
JOIN SCMS.BC_THANH_VIEN bt ON bt.ID = gt.BC_THANH_VIEN_ID
WHERE dct.MA_CHI_TIEU = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' -- Xác nhận
-- AND bt.CTCK_THONG_TIN_ID = :p_ctck_id
AND bt.TRANG_THAI IN (4, 6)
AND bt.XOA_DU_LIEU = 0
) margin_gt ON margin_gt.ngay = nd.ngay
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT
TRUNC(bt.NGAY_SO_LIEU) AS ngay,
